requirements.summary: Remove the Admin Special Password/Access Code field and all related UI copy from the signup completion form so role selection requires no extra code.
acceptanceCriteria: On the "Complete Your Signup" screen, selecting Admin or Engineer does not reveal any additional code input field.
No user-facing text mentions "Admin Special Password", "special password", or "Access Code" during signup.
Signup can be submitted successfully for both Admin and Engineer roles without entering any code.

file_operations.description: Remove access-code state, conditional access-code UI block, and any related helper text/copy; ensure role selection does not reveal any additional input and the form can submit without an access code. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Remove frontend validation and signup error-message translation that enforces or references any admin/engineer access-code requirement.
acceptanceCriteria: The signup form no longer calls any access-code validation (e.g., no validation errors requiring a 6-digit code).
The signup error translation utility no longer returns messages prompting for an admin/access code or indicating an invalid admin/access code.
No unused access-code validation helpers remain referenced by the signup form.

file_operations.description: Remove the 6-digit access-code validation helper and any access-code-specific validation messages so the validation module no longer contains code-gate logic.
Remove translations for backend errors related to missing/invalid admin/access codes so the utility no longer produces user prompts referencing special passwords/access codes.

Update imports and validation logic to stop referencing removed access-code validators and to eliminate access-code-specific error state handling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Update the frontend signup mutation call so it no longer sends any access code value during signup, consistent with removing the access-code UI.
acceptanceCriteria: The signup mutation no longer reads from an access-code input state variable.
The request to signupWithRole does not include any user-entered code value.

file_operations.description: Update the signup mutation helper (currently useSignupWithCode) to remove the adminCode argument and call signupWithRole using only the candid-supported parameters (profile and requestedRole).

Update the submit handler to stop providing any admin/access code value to the signup mutation payload and to stop reading from any access-code state. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
